{{Top|leg}}
The '''Elders of Gand''' were the leaders of [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] society. They sent the ''[[ruetsavii]]'' to evaluate Gands who wished to be judged as ''[[janwuine]]'' and thus earn the right to refer to themselves in the first person. Alternatively, they could also grant a Gand the title of [[Findsman/Legends|findsman]].<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
